Autonomous decisions.Game-confirmed execution.

04OPEN RUNTIME / MANAGED CLOUD

Take game AI from a playable prototype to production.

Your team keeps control of gameplay, world rules, and character experience. OpenGameAgent provides the open runtime, with production cloud services available when the project needs reliable capacity, realtime interaction, and long-term operations.

Explore production services →
OPEN / RUNTIMEThe execution core for game charactersOpen source · local · under your control
GOAL LOOP

Goal-driven planning and tool execution

Characters combine personality, context, and goals into execution steps, use dialogue, movement, trade, combat, or building tools, and continuously adjust plans from results.

GAME TIME

Game time and task scheduling

Characters understand turns, day and night, dates, and phases, schedule tasks in future game time, and preserve one timeline through pauses, calendar advances, and reconnection.

ACTOR RUNTIME

Independent multi-character execution and collaboration

One world can run multiple character agents. Each retains independent memory, tasks, and messages, with ordered action, parallel thinking, delegation, and collaboration.

AGENT / CLOUDProduction infrastructure for launchModels · realtime · scale and recovery
MODEL GATEWAY

Model capacity and intelligent routing

Connect language, speech, vision, and generation models through one layer, route by quality, latency, availability, and cost, and switch automatically during peaks or failures.

REALTIME

Realtime voice and multimodal interaction

Support streaming dialogue, player interruption, character voices, subtitles, and animation events while bringing text, speech, visuals, and game events into one live interaction.

AGENT SCALE

Durable workflows and character concurrency

Operate multi-character scheduling, asynchronous jobs, long-running state, and failure recovery so one character, an entire town, or an evolving world can run reliably.
